title: Rectangular prism (2 parts)
spec:
In the first part, start by setting up a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on this plane, which consists of two loops. In the first loop, draw a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.3068), followed by a line from (0.75, 0.3068) to (0.0, 0.3068), and finally back to the origin. For the second loop, draw a line from (0.0341, 0.0341) to (0.7159, 0.0341), then from (0.7159, 0.0341) to (0.7159, 0.2727), followed by a line from (0.7159, 0.2727) to (0.0341, 0.2727), and finally back to (0.0341, 0.0341). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0085 units in the direction of the normal to create a solid body. The resulting shape is a rectangular prism with a flat top and bottom, and four rectangular faces. The dimensions are length 0.75, width 0.3068, and height 0.0085.

In the second part, set up another new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.0618, 0.0959, 0.0085). Draw the second two-dimensional sketch, which consists of eight faces. For the first face, draw a line from (0.0, 0.0064) to (0.0128, 0.0064), then an arc from (0.0128, 0.0064) to (0.0, 0.0064) with a midpoint at (0.0064, 0.0). For the second face, draw a line from (0.0, 0.0064) to (0.0128, 0.0064), then an arc from (0.0128, 0.0064) to (0.0, 0.0064) with a midpoint at (0.0064, 0.0128). For the third face, draw an arc from (0.0, 0.0064) to (0.0128, 0.0064) with a midpoint at (0.0064, 0.0128), then a line from (0.0128, 0.0064) to (0.0128, 0.1768), followed by a line from (0.0128, 0.1768) to (0.0, 0.1768), and finally back to (0.0, 0.0064). For the fourth face, draw a line from (0.0, 0.1768) to (0.0128, 0.1768), then a line from (0.0128, 0.1768) to (0.0128, 0.2109), followed by a line from (0.0128, 0.2109) to (0.0, 0.2109), and finally back to (0.0, 0.1768). For the fifth face, draw a line from (0.6136, 0.0064) to (0.6264, 0.0064), then an arc from (0.6264, 0.0064) to (0.6136, 0.0064) with a midpoint at (0.62, 0.0). For the sixth face, draw a line from (0.6136, 0.0064) to (0.6264, 0.0064), then an arc from (0.6264, 0.0064) to (0.6136, 0.0064) with a midpoint at (0.62, 0.0128). For the seventh face, draw an arc from (0.6136, 0.0064) to (0.6264, 0.0064) with a midpoint at (0.62, 0.0128), then a line from (0.6264, 0.0064) to (0.6264, 0.1768), followed by a line from (0.6264, 0.1768) to (0.6136, 0.1768), and finally back to (0.6136, 0.0064). For the eighth face, draw a line from (0.6136, 0.1768) to (0.6264, 0.1768), then a line from (0.6264, 0.1768) to (0.6264, 0.2109), followed by a line from (0.6264, 0.2109) to (0.6136, 0.2109), and finally back to (0.6136, 0.1768). Apply a scale factor of 0.6264 to the entire sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the translation vector set to (0.0618, 0.0959, 0.0085). Extrude the sketch 0.0085 units in the direction of the normal to create a solid body. The resulting shape is a simple, symmetrical structure with a rectangular base and a smaller rectangular top. It has a central vertical line dividing the structure into two equal halves. The dimensions are length 0.6264, width 0.2109, and height 0.0085.

import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Rectangular Frame
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.3068).lineTo(0, 0.3068).close() \
    .moveTo(0.0403, 0.0341).lineTo(0.7097, 0.0341).lineTo(0.7097, 0.2727).lineTo(0.0403, 0.2727).close() \
    .extrude(0.0085)

# Part 2: Vertical Bars
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0.0766).lineTo(0.0085, 0.0766).lineTo(0.0085, 0.2727).lineTo(0, 0.2727).close() \
    .moveTo(0.6821, 0.0766).lineTo(0.6906, 0.0766).lineTo(0.6906, 0.2727).lineTo(0.6821, 0.2727).close() \
    .extrude(0.0085)

# Translate part_2 to the correct position
part_2 = part_2.translate((0.0297, 0.0341, 0.0085))

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.union(part_2)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
LX = 0.75     # X extent
LY = 0.3068   # Y extent
T  = 0.012    # frame plate thickness
BAR_H = 0.005 # bar height above frame (total Z = 0.017)
WALL = 0.025  # frame wall width
BAR_W = 0.010 # bar width
BAR_Y1 = 0.105 # bottom (rounded end) of bars

# Frame: outer box with inner rectangular cutout
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").box(LX, LY, T, centered=False)
inner = (cq.Workplane("XY")
         .box(LX - 2*WALL, LY - 2*WALL, T, centered=False)
         .translate((WALL, WALL, 0)))
frame = outer.cut(inner)

# Two bars on top of the frame, running along Y, rounded lower ends
bars = None
for xc in (0.07, 0.68):
    bar = (cq.Workplane("XY")
           .moveTo(xc - BAR_W/2.0, BAR_Y1)
           .lineTo(xc - BAR_W/2.0, LY)
           .lineTo(xc + BAR_W/2.0, LY)
           .lineTo(xc + BAR_W/2.0, BAR_Y1)
           .close()
           .extrude(BAR_H))
    tip = (cq.Workplane("XY")
           .center(xc, BAR_Y1)
           .circle(BAR_W/2.0)
           .extrude(BAR_H))
    bar = bar.union(tip).translate((0, 0, T))
    bars = bar if bars is None else bars.union(bar)

r = frame.union(bars)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
W = 0.75        # X length
H = 0.3068      # Y width
t = 0.012       # frame plate thickness
rib_t = 0.005   # raised rib height (total Z = 0.017)
border = 0.03   # frame border width

# Main flat rectangular frame with central opening
frame = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(W, H)
    .rect(W - 2 * border, H - 2 * border)
    .extrude(t)
)

# Raised ribs with rounded free ends, on the top edge (Y max side),
# one near each end of the frame
w = 0.014            # rib width
r_end = w / 2        # radius of rounded end
y_top = H / 2        # outer top edge of frame
y_arc = y_top - 0.203  # center of the semicircular rib end (0.21 reach total)

xc1 = -0.305         # left rib center (x = 0.07 from left edge)
xc2 = 0.305          # right rib center (x = 0.68 from left edge)

ribs = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=t)
    # left rib
    .moveTo(xc1 - r_end, y_top)
    .lineTo(xc1 - r_end, y_arc)
    .threePointArc((xc1, y_arc - r_end), (xc1 + r_end, y_arc))
    .lineTo(xc1 + r_end, y_top)
    .close()
    # right rib
    .moveTo(xc2 - r_end, y_top)
    .lineTo(xc2 - r_end, y_arc)
    .threePointArc((xc2, y_arc - r_end), (xc2 + r_end, y_arc))
    .lineTo(xc2 + r_end, y_top)
    .close()
    .extrude(rib_t)
)

# Final part
r = frame.union(ribs)
